AAVE is a decentralized lending and borrowing protocol that operates on smart contracts. AAVE supports overcollateralized loans and flash loans. AAVE is governed by holders of its AAVE token.

Curve is a decentralized exchange that specializes in swaps between stablecoins and other pegged assets. Curve uses liquidity pools built on smart contracts. Curve is governed by holders of its CRV token.

MakerDAO is a decentralized system that issues the DAI stablecoin. MakerDAO relies on overcollateralized crypto-asset vaults to back DAI. MakerDAO is governed by holders of its MKR token.

Morpho is a decentralized lending protocol that matches lenders and borrowers peer-to-peer on top of existing lending pools. Morpho runs on smart contracts on public blockchains. Morpho offers permissionless isolated lending markets.
